mapper.select: SELECT d.doc_id, d.doc_type, d.title, d.status, d.initiator_id, d.draft_date, d.json_content, d.updated_at, d.version, u.id AS initiator_id, u.name AS initiator_name, u.department AS initiator_department, u.rank_name AS initiator_rank FROM documents d JOIN users u ON d.initiator_id = u.id WHERE doc_id= #{docId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents ( doc_type, title, status, draft_date, json_content, updated_at, initiator_id ) VALUES ( #{docType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{jsonContent, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, NOW(), #{initiatorId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO documents ( doc_type, title, status, initiator_id, draft_date, json_content, updated_at
) VALUES ( #{docType}, #{title}, #{status}, #{initiatorId}, NOW(), #{jsonContent}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE documents SET status = #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = #{updatedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, version = version + 1 WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM approval_history WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT d.doc_id, d.doc_type, d.title, d.status, d.initiator_id, d.draft_date, d.json_content, d.updated_at, u_initiator.name AS initiator_name, u_initiator.department AS initiator_department FROM documents d JOIN approval_history ah ON d.doc_id = ah.doc_id JOIN users u_initiator ON d.initiator_id = u_initiator.id WHERE ah.approver_id = #{approverId} AND ah.approval_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY d.draft_date DESC

SELECT d.doc_id, d.doc_type, d.title, d.status, d.initiator_id, d.draft_date, d.json_content, d.updated_at, /* 기안자 정보 JOIN (필요할 경우) */ u.name AS initiator_name, u.department AS initiator_department FROM documents d LEFT JOIN users u ON d.initiator_id = u.id WHERE d.initiator_id = #{initiatorId} AND d.status IN ('REJECTED', 'RECALLED') ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC

SELECT d.doc_id, d.doc_type, d.title, d.status, d.initiator_id, d.draft_date, d.json_content, d.updated_at FROM documents d WHERE d.initiator_id = #{initiatorId} AND d.status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY d.draft_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE attachment SET origin_name = #{origin_name}, saved_name = #{saved_name}, file_path = #{file_path}, file_size = #{file_size}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE doc_id = #{doc_id} AND status IN ('REJECTED', 'RECALLED', 'TEMP')
UPDATE documents SET title= #{title}, json_content = #{jsonContent}, status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND status IN ('REJECTED', 'RECALLED', 'TEMP')
UPDATE documents SET title = #{title}, json_content = #{jsonContent}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND status= 'TEMP'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachment ( doc_id, origin_name, saved_name, file_path, file_size ) VALUES ( #{docId}, #{originName}, #{savedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize} )
mapper.select: SELECT d.doc_id, d.doc_type, d.title, d.status, d.initiator_id, d.draft_date, d.json_content, d.updated_at, u.id AS initiator_id, u.name AS initiator_name, u.department AS initiator_department, u.rank_name AS initiator_rank FROM documents d JOIN users u ON d.initiator_id = u.id WHERE d.status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND d.initiator_id = #{userId}

SELECT d.doc_id, d.doc_type, d.title, d.status, d.initiator_id, d.draft_date, d.json_content, d.updated_at, u.id AS initiator_id, u.name AS initiator_name, u.department AS initiator_department, u.rank_name AS initiator_rank FROM documents d JOIN users u ON d.initiator_id = u.id WHERE d.status IN ('APPROVED') AND d.initiator_id = #{userId}

SELECT d.doc_id, d.doc_type, d.title, d.status, d.initiator_id, d.draft_date, d.json_content, d.updated_at, u.id AS initiator_id, u.name AS initiator_name, u.department AS initiator_department, u.rank_name AS initiator_rank FROM documents d JOIN users u ON d.initiator_id = u.id WHERE d.status IN ('TEMP') AND d.initiator_id = #{userId}

SELECT d.doc_id, d.doc_type, d.title, d.status, d.initiator_id, d.draft_date, d.json_content, d.updated_at, u.id AS initiator_id, u.name AS initiator_name, u.department AS initiator_department, u.rank_name AS initiator_rank FROM documents d JOIN approval_history ah ON d.doc_id = ah.doc_id JOIN users u ON d.initiator_id = u.id WHERE ah.approver_id = #{userId} AND ah.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND d.status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS')
